text:
Sana Kumar: Heads up — integration suite went red on hosted-integ-shard-21. Repro is: failures when tests exercise streaming + tool-calling; a mix of 503s from the API and a schema error in the tool payload. Can someone kick a rerun and help triage?
CI Bot: failed tests: integ.tool_call_streaming.test_tool_sequence, integ.auth_streaming.test_stream_auth_refresh. Sample failure: 
ERROR 503 ServiceUnavailable - upstream auth-proxy returned 503
SchemaError: expected object for 'tool_call', got 'string'
Jonathan Lee: I saw a reproduction locally hitting our staging proxy — gets a 503 occasionally when token rotation is happening. Quick curl repro: 
```
curl -i -X POST "https://hosted.api.redwood/v1/generate"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -d '{"stream":true,"input":"call tool"}'
```
Headers look normal but upstream auth-proxy log shows "missing kid header" right before the 503.
Emma Rodriguez: /ci rerun --shards shard-21,shard-22 (started). If green we can rule out flake, if red we should bisect.
Triage Bot: history: shard-21 has 5 failures in last 7 days, mostly auth-streaming flakes. Increasing probability this is related to yesterday's auth handshake change.
Olivia Park: I can take a bisect if rerun stays red. Need the commit range — what rolled yesterday?
Sanjeev Patel: The recent change was kernel-selection/auth-proxy-negotiation commit 4f3c2b8..9a1d7ef (rollout: small config tweak in auth proxy w/ kid rotation logic). Could be a timing regression when stream starts.
Sana Kumar: PR that rolled it: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1427 — landed in main at 4f3c2b8. If rerun still red, Olivia please bisect from 4f3c2b8^ to main.
Olivia Park: starting bisect now: `/ci bisect --start 4f3c2b7 --end main --shards shard-21 --target integ.tool_call_streaming.test_tool_sequence`
CI Bot: bisect progress: narrowed to commit 4f3c2b8 -> change in auth proxy: switched to rotate `kid` on first handshake for streaming sessions.
Olivia Park: Confirmed — reverting 4f3c2b8 locally removes the 503 in the curl repro. Will open a revert/patch and request hotfix.
Sana Kumar: thanks — please add the quick test to the flaky-tests ignore list only if we land a proper fix. For now open hotfix PR and tag @Emma for the emergency rollout.
Emma Rodriguez: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1435 (revert 4f3c2b8). Triggering emergency rollout to dedicated staging.
CI Bot: rerun (post-revert) started for shard-21 and shard-22.
CI Bot: rerun results: shard-21 ✅, shard-22 ✅ — all green.
Sana Kumar: nice work. Marking this triaged. Follow-up: add an integration test specifically for kid-rotation timing and add a short-run canary for streaming auth in the smoke suite.
Sanjeev Patel: will add the canary and a few more logs to the auth-proxy to break down timing.
Olivia Park: thumbs up — logging PR incoming.
Jonathan Lee: good catch, thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
